para: a journey, trade route, migration, from A to B to C, how far it travels
ficha: Tilted 3D map; a glowing route is traced place by place, a pin drops on each spoken word; on the last word the camera pulls back to the whole journey.

para: a place named for the first time, here, where it happened, zooming in
ficha: 3D Earth in space turns and the camera dives to one place, landing on the word with a dropping pin. Optional photo irises open from the pin.

para: a country or region singled out, it stood alone, the one place that
ficha: Scale-model board: country pieces fall in one by one, then on the word the named country rises as a tall lit block while its neighbors dim.

para: old voyage, treasure, a secret place, history, expedition, X marks the spot
ficha: A parchment scroll unrolls on a wooden table, an ink route draws itself place by place, and a red X slams on the last place.

para: it spread, reached everywhere, an outbreak, an empire, news, influence, from one place
ficha: Dark tilted map; on the word a wave of light leaves one place and ignites the land as the camera pulls back, arcs reaching other places.

para: visiting places, several locations each with a picture, a tour, stops along the way
ficha: 3D map; a framed photo stands up from each place on its word while the camera flies from one to the next along a drawn line.
